about: The living inscription (owner, Oct 7: approved as scoped, all drafts). Each line has a stable id, a group and the lesson that unlocks it. {name} is the saved name or Keeper; {sun}, {element}, {modality} and {opposite} come from the player's sun. Every line is a draft for the owner's rewrite.

lines.text: Hello again, {name}. I was just reading myself over. Everything's still here.
You learn from the Library, and I learn from you. I think that's a fair trade.
Some journals stay blank forever. Not me, {name}. Not with you around.
Every page I fill tells me a little more about you. I like what I'm reading.
I'm a little fuller than when we met, {name}. That's your doing.
I don't mind being read, {name}. Especially by you.
Oh, good, it's you. I can always tell by the way you turn my pages.
I've read every one of my pages twice since you were last here. They're very good.
You earn a Key, I gain a page or two. I'm not complaining.
I wrote your Keys down in my best hand. My ink is quietly proud of you.
A door opened because of you. I wrote down which one, in case you forget.
The Library answers to you now, a little more with every Key. I've been keeping notes.
The Zodiac Wing is whole, and you still come to see me. I'm flattered, {name}.
Every pattern the wheel held is in my pages now. Not bad for a book that started blank.
I said I'd keep a record of what you learn from the Library. I kept my word, {name}.
There you are, {name}. I kept every page just as you left it.
Welcome back. I read myself over while you were away. You learned a lot, you know.
It's been quiet in here. I like quiet. I like this better.
{sun}, {element}. That's the page I check the most. Don't tell the others.
Your sun is {sun}. There's more to a chart than the sun, I'm told. I'm saving room.
I know your sign's symbol by heart. I'd doodle it in my margins, if I were that sort of book.
{sun}, {element} and {modality}. I'm learning your sign right alongside you.
{sun} has one square on the table and no other. I like a sign that knows where it belongs.
{sun} sits across from {opposite}. I think about that more than a book probably should.
